etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Latin decoratus, past participle of decorare (“to adorn, distinguish, honor”), from decus (“ornament, grace, dignity, honor”), akin to decor (“elegance, grace, beauty, ornament”), from decet (“adorn, befit”).

definitions.definition: (transitive) To improve the appearance of an interior of, as a house, room, or office.
(intransitive) To add adornments to an interior space, as a house, room, or office.
(transitive) To honor by providing a medal, ribbon, or other adornment.
(programming, transitive) To extend a method, etc. by attaching some further code item.
